svg.text: End-to-end OIDC user identity federation to Databricks Unity Catalog
Propagates authenticated Google Cloud user identities for Unity Catalog row/column enforcement and per-user audit logging

g.text: Serves cached Parquet blocks ONLY after
EXTERNAL USE SCHEMA -> vends read token
Practitioner setup guidance: Single-user trial quickstart vs. multi-user enterprise OIDC

svg.text: • Trial quickstart: AUTH_MODE="secret" + IDENTITY_MODE="service-identity" • Multi-user governance: AUTH_MODE="oidc" + IDENTITY_MODE="user-identity-federation"
